source_set_format: sha256 two spaces leaf-relative path LF sorted; receipt/validation outputs excluded

implementation.native_entry: bcp_native_derive_and_configure(base_policy,caller_workspace,out_receipt), no caller raw setup/address or detached receipt.
boot_sequence: Pure policy/workspace/output validation before any pin call.
Native one-attempt pin callback owns frozen bpn_native_pin_empty; captures actual setup into small local state.
Typed getter/profile and pmap query callbacks derive protection from that held setup with full checks.
Exact internally derived candidate/setup/final policy/protection go to frozen bpn_native_configure once.
Known configure success and post-call consistency checks precede public configured receipt commit; failures leave public output unchanged, no rollback/retry.
implementation.types: Exact private KDK preinclude mach/vm_types.h then arm/locks.h; static_assert mutex16/align8, ppnum32, addr64 and function signatures. No sizeof(IOLock), guessed bucket extent or invented pmap type in production.
implementation.policy: Original RAM intervals retain their boundaries for entire-page membership and final policy; canonical sorting only. Complete exact CPU/PA page union and final forbidden union preserve all base reservations without gap bridging or truncation.
implementation.receipt: Source hashes, full setup/type/source identity, ordered CPU/ppnum/PA vector, canonical base/final policies and complete protection. Caller workspace holds expected/candidate receipts and snapshots. Field-wise checks avoid padding identity. Provenance=held setup identity is an explicit non-cryptographic label.
implementation.native_retry: Native pin-attempt flag set before frozen pin invocation; no further attempt after return/failure/nonreturn. Pure preflight refusal before pin does not consume it.

trusted_limits: Low-level injected derive/boot APIs are trusted/internal/test interfaces, not user-controlled VA/PA entry points. Their callbacks and accessible immutable input/workspace lifetimes remain caller responsibilities.

Real wrapper must run under trusted single-threaded boot sequencing before any backing clients/waiters/remap/free/unload. The frozen raw configure entry remains callable by privileged code; helper is not a security boundary.
Two equal mapping samples establish consistency between samples only, not future immutability or protection against arbitrary remapping.
Protected coverage is typed anchor and underlying16-byte mutex plus their full intersecting pages, not all allocator/slab/turnstile/global metadata.
Output commit is a caller-serialized transaction, not atomic multiword publication; workspace may change on failure.
Known or unknown configuration failure has no rollback. Controls remain boot-retained and the caller must stop; no data backing experiment is admitted.
